categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies `test/functional/test_framework/key.py`, which is part of the functional test framework machinery, and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Corrects RFC 6979 nonce derivation in the test framework's ECKey helper to match libsecp256k1 for hashes exceeding the curve order. The author explicitly notes that the issue has no practical effect on existing tests, as signatures remained valid and double-SHA256 hashes exceed n with negligible probability (about 2^-128).
